name: Non Distributed - US Titanium Ingot Production Mix
notes:
This mix does not include transmission losses. It only aggregates the electricity mix used both for domestic titanium ingot (as well as forged ingot and powder) production in the US, and for ingot (or forged ingot/powder) imported from various sources into the US. 

Publication Title: Life-Cycle Inventory of Critical Materials – Nickel, Copper, Titanium and Rare-Earth Elements 
Authors: R.K. Iyer and J.C. Kelly
Year: 2022

Based on USGS data
